model.files.common

Class JsonFile<T extends ICommonFileModel>

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.files.common.BaseFile<T>
      • model.files.common.JsonFile<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - extends ICommonFileModel
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    IFileMethods<T>
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    MyFilesHolder, MyLocationsHolder

    public abstract class JsonFile<T extends ICommonFileModel>
extends BaseFile<T>
    This is the extension on top of BaseFile that will extend the functionality of the files in order to parse JSON contents from the input and output files.
    See Also:
    ICommonFileModel, BaseFile

    • Method Detail

      • ParseFile

        public HashMap<Integer,T> ParseFile()
                             throws DataFileException
        This method is used to parse a generic json file that supports type of T as model, and will parse to the type of T in the override method of parseJSON in each class that derives from this class. If the input file is missing or empty, a message is printed and the returned map is empty.
        Specified by:
        ParseFile in class BaseFile<T extends ICommonFileModel>
        Returns:
        HashMap<Integer, T>, where T is the model of the object to be read from the input file. Because T extends ICommonFileModel, it has access to the getId method from T.
        Throws:
        DataFileException - In the case the input file cannot be read or it does not contain a valid JSON throws this exception.
        See Also:
        MyFilesHolder, MyLocationsHolder

      • parseJSON

        protected abstract List<T> parseJSON(String jsonStr)

      • WriteFile

        public void WriteFile(Collection<T> objectsToWrite)
               throws DataFileException
        This method is used to write the objects in the output file, as JSON, using the override method of toJSON from each class that derives from this class. It is called when the application is closed. For the holders the output file is the same as the input file, so the next start reads the saved data.
        Specified by:
        WriteFile in class BaseFile<T extends ICommonFileModel>
        Parameters:
        objectsToWrite - The objects to be written in the output file
        Throws:
        DataFileException - In the case the output file cannot be written throws this exception.
        See Also:
        ParseFile()

      • toJSON

        protected abstract String toJSON(Collection<T> myFilesList)
